description: This file contains implementation of UE (User Equipment) configuration management, including classes and methods for handling UE cell configurations, search space management, DCI size calculations, and PDCCH candidate processing within a 5G NR scheduler context.

classes.name: search_space_info
classes.description: Represents a search space configuration for PDCCH monitoring, including candidate management and DCI configuration.

classes.name: ue_cell_configuration
classes.description: Manages UE-specific cell configuration, including BWP setup, search space configuration, and DCI size calculations.

classes.name: ue_configuration
classes.description: Represents overall UE configuration, including multiple cell configurations, logical channels, and reconfiguration logic.

methods.name: get_k1_candidates
methods.description: Returns the list of candidate timing values based on DCI format.

methods.name: update_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Updates the list of PDCCH candidates for a search space based on provided candidate data.

methods.name: update_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Updates the PDSCH time domain list based on UE cell configuration.

methods.name: update_pdsch_mappings
methods.description: Updates the PDSCH resource mappings based on interleaving bundle size.

methods.name: is_dci_format_monitored_in_ue_ss
methods.description: Checks if a specific DCI format is monitored in UE-specific search spaces.

methods.name: get_dci_size_config
methods.description: Generates DCI size configuration parameters for a given search space.

methods.name: compute_nof_dl_ports
methods.description: Calculates the number of downlink ports for a UE serving cell configuration.

methods.name: get_dl_dci_size
methods.description: Retrieves the DCI size for a given search space info.

methods.name: remove_ambiguous_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Removes ambiguous PDCCH candidates according to TS 38.213 rules.

methods.name: apply_pdcch_candidate_monitoring_limits
methods.description: Limits the number of monitored PDCCH candidates and non-overlapped CCEs per slot.

methods.name: generate_crnti_monitored_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Generates the list of PDCCH candidates monitored for a given slot and CRNTI.

methods.name: assert_dci_size_config
methods.description: Validates the DCI size configuration for a search space.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures UE cell configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: set_rrm_config
methods.description: Sets RRM resource allocation policies for the UE.

methods.name: configure_bwp_common_cfg
methods.description: Configures common BWP parameters and search spaces.

methods.name: configure_bwp_ded_cfg
methods.description: Configures dedicated BWP parameters and search spaces.

methods.name: is_cfg_dedicated_complete
methods.description: Checks if the dedicated configuration for a UE cell is complete.

methods.name: is_ul_enabled
methods.description: Determines if uplink is enabled for a given slot.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the overall UE configuration with new cell and policy parameters.

methods.name: is_ue_cfg_complete
methods.description: Checks if the UE configuration is complete.
